reasons.claim: 1 eligible species within 250 m: Tricholoma roseoacerbum (VU fungus, site-bound, forest-associated), reported 21 m from the edge, 2026. Its listed threats include lack of continuity forest, lack of large/old trees and ground disturbance from forestry.
Supporting: 1 NT site-bound forest species (Hydnellum caeruleum, 246 m, 2023).
No completed felling overlaps the 2.94 ha polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.
Effort is adequate (81st percentile), but near-site recording is thin: 3 records on 2 days within 250 m and none inside the polygon.

uncertainties: The only eligible record has 200 m coordinate uncertainty, more than twice the site's equivalent radius (97 m). It may not lie near the polygon at all. It still qualifies under the 250 m rule, so I kept the rubric hint.
not_established: Whether the VU fungus occurs inside or adjacent to the polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Human reviewer should examine the 2026 Tricholoma roseoacerbum record, with its 200 m uncertainty, against the polygon, and consider a targeted field check before felling starts.
